Gabapentin can also cause swelling in the legs, feet, or hands (peripheral edema), which may add to weight changes and becomes more common with age.
Triplet: ["peripheral edema", "contributes to", "weight changes"]

The relation 'contributes to' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or event plays a role in causing or exacerbating the condition or change specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'may cause': The subject action or condition can lead to or contribute to the development of the medical condition or effect specified by the object entity.
C. 'affected by': The subject entity is influenced or altered by the factor specified by the object entity.
D. 'may be confused with': The subject condition or symptom may be mistaken for the condition or symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'involves buildup of': The subject condition involves the accumulation of the substance specified by the object entity.
